mn92:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā aṅguttarāpesu cārikañcaramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ aḍḍhatelasehi bhikkhusatehi yena āpaṇaṃ nāma aṅguttarāpānaṃ nigamo tadavasari.
mn92:2.2: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito aṅguttarāpesu cārikañcaramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ aḍḍhatelasehi bhikkhusatehi āpaṇaṃ anuppatto
mn92:2.3: taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃkalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato
mn92:2.4: itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā
mn92:2.5: so imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti
mn92:2.6: so dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti
mn92:2.7: sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotīti.
mn92:3.1: atha kho keṇiyo jaṭilo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
mn92:3.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
mn92:3.3: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho keṇiyaṃ jaṭilaṃ bhagavā dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
mn92:3.4: atha kho keṇiyo jaṭilo bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
mn92:3.5: adhivāsetu me bhavaṃ gotamo svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenāti.
mn92:3.6: evaṃ vutte bhagavā keṇiyaṃ jaṭilaṃ etadavoca
mn92:3.7: mahā kho keṇiya bhikkhusaṅgho aḍḍhatelasāni bhikkhusatāni tvañca brāhmaṇesu abhippasannoti.
mn92:3.8: dutiyampi kho keṇiyo jaṭilo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
mn92:3.9: kiñcāpi bho gotama mahābhikkhusaṅgho aḍḍhatelasāni bhikkhusatāni ahañca brāhmaṇesu abhippasanno
mn92:3.10: adhivāsetu me bhavaṃ gotamo svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenāti.
mn92:3.11: dutiyampi kho bhagavā keṇiyaṃ jaṭilaṃ etadavoca
mn92:3.12: mahā kho keṇiya bhikkhusaṅgho aḍḍhatelasāni bhikkhusatāni tvañca brāhmaṇesu abhippasannoti.
mn92:3.13: tatiyampi kho keṇiyo jaṭilo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
mn92:3.14: kiñcāpi bho gotama mahābhikkhusaṅgho aḍḍhatelasāni bhikkhusatāni ahañca brāhmaṇesu abhippasanno
mn92:3.15: adhivāsetveva me bhavaṃ gotamo svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenāti.
mn92:4.1: atha kho keṇiyo jaṭilo bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā yena sako assamo tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā mittāmacce ñātisālohite āmantesi
mn92:4.3: samaṇo gotamo nimantito svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena
mn92:4.5: evaṃ bhoti kho keṇiyassa jaṭilassa mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā keṇiyassa jaṭilassa paṭissutvā appekacce uddhanāni khananti appekacce kaṭṭhāni phālenti appekacce bhājanāni dhovanti appekacce udakamaṇikaṃ patiṭṭhāpenti appekacce āsanāni paññāpenti.
mn92:5.1: tena kho pana samayena selo brāhmaṇo āpaṇe paṭivasati tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ padako veyyākaraṇo lokāyatamahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo tīṇi māṇavakasatāni mante vāceti.
mn92:6.1: tena kho pana samayena keṇiyo jaṭilo sele brāhmaṇe abhippasanno hoti.
mn92:6.2: atha kho selo brāhmaṇo tīhi māṇavakasatehi parivuto jaṅghāvihāraṃ anucaṅkamamāno anuvicaramāno yena keṇiyassa jaṭilassa assamo tenupasaṅkami.
mn92:6.3: addasā kho selo brāhmaṇo keṇiyasmiṃ jaṭile appekacce uddhanāni khanante appekacce kaṭṭhāni phālente appekacce bhājanāni dhovante appekacce udakamaṇikaṃ patiṭṭhāpente appekacce āsanāni paññāpente keṇiyaṃ jaṭilaṃ sāmaññeva maṇḍalamāḷaṃ paṭiyādentaṃ
mn92:7.2: kiṃ nu bhoto keṇiyassa āvāho vā bhavissati vivāho vā bhavissati mahāyañño vā paccupaṭṭhito rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro nimantito svātanāya saddhiṃ balakāyenāti.
mn92:8.1: na me bho sela āvāho vā bhavissati napi vivāho vā bhavissati napi rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro nimantito svātanāya saddhiṃ balakāyena
mn92:8.3: atthi samaṇo gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito aṅguttarāpesu cārikañcaramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ aḍḍhatelasehi bhikkhusatehi āpaṇaṃ anuppatto
mn92:8.4: taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃkalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato
mn92:8.5: itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti
mn92:8.6: so me nimantito svātanāya saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenāti.
mn92:10.2: ghosopi kho eso dullabho lokasmiṃ yadidaṃ buddhoti
mn92:10.3: āgatāni kho panamhākaṃ mantesu dvattiṃsa mahāpurisalakkhaṇāni yehi samannāgatassa mahāpurisassa dveva gatiyo bhavanti anaññā
mn92:10.4: sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati rājā hoti cakkavatti dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthā viriyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato
mn92:10.6: cakkaratanaṃ hatthiratanaṃ assaratanaṃ maṇiratanaṃ itthīratanaṃ gahapatiratanaṃ parināyakaratanameva sattamaṃ
mn92:10.7: parosahassaṃ kho panassa puttā bhavanti sūrā vīraṅgarūpā parasenappamaddanā
mn92:10.8: so imaṃ paṭhaviṃ sāgarapariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasati
mn92:10.9: sace pana agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati arahaṃ hoti sammāsambuddho loke vivaṭacchado
mn92:11.1: kahaṃ pana bho keṇiya etarahi so bhavaṃ gotamo viharati arahaṃ sammāsambuddhoti.
mn92:11.2: evaṃ vutte keṇiyo jaṭilo dakkhiṇaṃ bāhaṃ paggahetvā selaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca
mn92:12.1: atha kho selo brāhmaṇo tīhi māṇavakasatehi saddhiṃ yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami.
mn92:12.2: atha kho selo brāhmaṇo te māṇavake āmantesi
mn92:12.3: appasaddā bhonto āgacchantu pade padaṃ nikkhipantā
mn92:12.4: durā sadā hi te bhavanto sīhāva ekacarā
mn92:12.5: yadā cāhaṃ bhotā samaṇena gotamena saddhiṃ manteyyaṃ mā me bhonto antarantarā kathaṃ opātetha
mn92:13.1: atha kho selo brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
mn92:13.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
mn92:13.3: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho selo brāhmaṇo bhagavato kāye dvattiṃsa mahāpurisalakkhaṇāni sammannesi.
mn92:13.4: addasā kho selo brāhmaṇo bhagavato kāye dvattiṃsa mahāpurisalakkhaṇāni yebhuyyena ṭhapetvā dve
mn92:13.5: dvīsu mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na saṃpasīdati
mn92:13.8: passati kho me ayaṃ selo brāhmaṇo dvattiṃsa mahāpurisalakkhaṇāni yebhuyyena ṭhapetvā dve
mn92:13.9: dvīsu mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na saṃpasīdati
mn92:14.1: atha kho bhagavā tathārūpaṃ iddhābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhāresi yathā addasa selo brāhmaṇo bhagavato kosohitaṃ vatthaguyhaṃ.
mn92:14.2: atha kho bhagavā jivhaṃ ninnāmetvā ubhopi kaṇṇasotāni anumasi paṭimasi ubhopi nāsikasotāni anumasi paṭimasi kevalakappaṃ nalāṭamaṇḍalaṃ jivhāya chādesi.
mn92:15.2: samannāgato kho samaṇo gotamo dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇehi paripuṇṇehi no apparipuṇṇehi
mn92:15.3: no ca kho naṃ jānāmi buddho vā no vā
mn92:15.4: sutaṃ pana metaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ vuḍḍhānaṃ mahallakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ
mn92:15.5: ye te bhavanti arahanto sammāsambuddhā te sake vaṇṇe bhaññamāne attānaṃ pātukarontīti
mn92:15.6: yannūnāhaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ sammukhā sāruppāhi gāthāhi abhitthaveyyanti.
mn92:15.7: atha kho selo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ sammukhā sāruppāhi gāthāhi abhitthavi
mn92:24.1: alattha kho selo brāhmaṇo sapariso bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ alattha upasampadaṃ.
mn92:25.1: atha kho keṇiyo jaṭilo tassā rattiyā accayena sake assame paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi
mn92:25.3: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena keṇiyassa jaṭilassa assamo tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena.
mn92:25.4: atha kho keṇiyo jaṭilo buddhappamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi.
mn92:25.5: atha kho keṇiyo jaṭilo bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ aññataraṃ nīcaṃ āsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
mn92:25.6: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho keṇiyaṃ jaṭilaṃ bhagavā imāhi gāthāhi anumodi
mn92:26.9: atha kho bhagavā keṇiyaṃ jaṭilaṃ imāhi gāthāhi anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
mn92:27.1: atha kho āyasmā selo sapariso vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto nacirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi
mn92:27.2: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ ithattāyāti abbhaññāsi.
mn92:27.3: aññataro kho panāyasmā selo sapariso arahataṃ ahosi.
mn92:28.1: atha kho āyasmā selo sapariso yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ cīvaraṃ katvā yena bhagavā tenañjalimpaṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi
